won.source: The Commission's own compiled Intergalactic Championship title history: won a four-way match against Sabre, Leyenda de Ocho and "the Jersey Devil" Troy Matthews at Survivalism (the ULTRATITLE Finale), by submission over Troy Matthews with a figure-four leglock. The show's own card is not held.

lost.source: The full show script for "Unlucky For Some 2013, Show I: Louisville": lost by pinfall to Magnus Destructo (Destructo Bomb)

how: Lost by pinfall to Magnus Destructo (Destructo Bomb) after kicking out of a set of brass knuckles.
note: The Commission's own title history also records two successful defenses in this reign not otherwise structured: over a four-way at "Sorry You're Not a Winner" (18 December 2012) and over Leyenda de Ocho in a three-stage match at "V for Victoralicious" (11 February 2013).
